fields.description: Issue includes extensive political commentary and accusations involving Florida public officials, focusing on State's Attorney Vernon Hawthorne and related grand jury and criminal-justice matters, with references to Miami Beach gambling and state politics. Also contains local election editorial content, sports coverage including horse-racing selections and boxing discussion, campus and society chatter, entertainment/nightlife notices, and numerous local business advertisements.
